news.headline: RB Jadarian Price ruled out by Seattle Seahawks for Week 4
news.description: The Seattle Seahawks on Friday ruled out running back Jadarian Price for their game Sunday against the Los Angeles Chargers, as the rookie deals with a chest injury suffered in Week 2 and aggravated in practice Wednesday, according to Mike Macdonald.

news.headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith out vs. Rams with hamstring injury
news.description: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith will miss Sunday's game due to a lingering hamstring injury and will be joined on the sideline by linebacker Zack Baun (concussion).

news.headline: Panthers in wait-and-see mode with leading receiver Coker (quad)
news.description: The Carolina Panthers are monitoring starting wide receiver Jalen Coker's quadriceps injury ahead of their Week 4 "Sunday Night Football" matchup with the Detroit Lions.

news.headline: Texans get WR Nico Collins (hamstring) back vs. Cowboys
news.description: The winless Texans got good news Friday as star wide receiver Nico Collins is set to return Sunday from a hamstring injury that forced him to miss Houston's last two games.

news.headline: Aaron Donald out, Puka Nacua to play in Rams' game vs. Eagles
news.description: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not play against the Eagles as he deals with back soreness, while wide receiver Puka Nacua will return from a hip injury after missing the past two games.

news.headline: Vikings' Justin Jefferson out vs. Dolphins with ankle injury
news.description: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson won't play against the Dolphins because of a sprained left ankle, but coach Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he can return in Week 5 vs. the Saints.

news.headline: 49ers WR Mike Evans a game-time decision with rib injury
news.description: Niners wide receiver Mike Evans is questionable for Sunday, but he said he will give "my best" to play against the Broncos as he deals with a rib injury.

news.headline: Fantasy football last-minute pickups for Week 4: Raymond, Allen, Waller among top options
news.description: If injuries or tough matchups have you seeking help, Matt Bowen provides options at each key position.

news.headline: Jets rule out RB Hall, WR Mitchell, TE Taylor, LG Parham vs. Bears
news.description: Running back Breece Hall, wide receiver Adonai Mitchell, tight end Mason Taylor and left guard Dylan Parham were ruled out Friday for the Jets' road game against the Bears.

news.headline: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba off to a historic start, but is it sustainable?
news.description: Seattle's star receiver is leading the NFL in receiving yards and TDs after signing a big contract extension this summer. But will the Seahawks look to spread the ball more?
